meta_description_en: Monthly news: MGT's new computer price rise due to RAM shortage, ZX Microfair announcement, circulation numbers, and an overview of current Spectrum magazines.
meta_description_ru: Новости месяца: подорожание будущего компьютера от MGT из-за дефицита RAM, анонс ZX Microfair, тиражи и обзор свежей прессы (Crash, Your Sinclair, Sinclair User).
body_en_plain:
Little news this month except to
report that the world shortage
of RAM chips is pushing up the
probable price of MGT's proposed
new computer (with the Spectrum
mode) to sub `150 rather than
sub `100. Launch may be August.
Existing +D and Disciple owners
may get the first opportunity at
the initial 10,000 machines.

The next ZX Microfair will be on
Saturday, 11th June from 10.00am
to 6.00pm at the Horticultural
Halls.

Circulation figures for Spectrum
magazines recently released are:

 Computer & Video Games.105,000
 Crash...................96,000
 Your Sinclair...........80,000
 Sinclair User...........78,000

Of interest in Your Sinclair
this month is a listing for a
file recovery program for the +3
and a shaded screen dump. Your
Computer has only a very short,
general item on printers.Nothing
Spectrum-related in Personal
Computer World. Sinclair User
has a little tutorial on how to
print characters from machine
code and a very brief review of
the Kempston Mouse. I think
you'd better stick with OUTLET!.

body_en:
## Lookout

Little news this month except to report that the world shortage of RAM chips is pushing up the probable price of MGT's proposed new computer (with the Spectrum mode) to sub £150 rather than sub £100. Launch may be August. Existing +D and Disciple owners may get the first opportunity at the initial 10,000 machines.

The next ZX Microfair will be on Saturday, 11th June from 10.00am to 6.00pm at the Horticultural Halls.

Circulation figures for Spectrum magazines recently released are:

| Magazine | Circulation |
| :--- | :--- |
| Computer & Video Games | 105,000 |
| Crash | 96,000 |
| Your Sinclair | 80,000 |
| Sinclair User | 78,000 |

Of interest in Your Sinclair this month is a listing for a file recovery program for the +3 and a shaded screen dump. Your Computer has only a very short, general item on printers. Nothing Spectrum-related in Personal Computer World. Sinclair User has a little tutorial on how to print characters from machine code and a very brief review of the Kempston Mouse. I think you'd better stick with OUTLET!.
body_ru:
## Lookout: Новости

Новостей в этом месяце немного, разве что стоит сообщить: мировой дефицит чипов RAM поднимает вероятную цену нового компьютера от MGT (с режимом Spectrum) до отметки ниже `150, а не ниже `100. Запуск может состояться в августе. Нынешние владельцы +D и Disciple могут первыми получить шанс приобрести машины из начальной партии в 10,000 штук.

Следующая ZX Microfair пройдёт в субботу, 11th June, с 10.00am до 6.00pm в Horticultural Halls.

Недавно были опубликованы тиражи журналов о Spectrum:

| Журнал | Тираж |
|---|---|
| Computer & Video Games | 105,000 |
| Crash | 96,000 |
| Your Sinclair | 80,000 |
| Sinclair User | 78,000 |

Из интересного в Your Sinclair в этом месяце — листинг программы восстановления файлов для +3 и полутоновый дамп экрана. В Your Computer есть лишь очень короткая общая заметка о принтерах. Ничего о Spectrum в Personal Computer World. В Sinclair User есть небольшое руководство по выводу символов из машинного кода и очень краткий обзор Kempston Mouse. Думаю, вам лучше оставаться с OUTLET!.
